title: It's not always clear which items are 'Chekhov's gun' consumables meant for a specific later puzzle (e.g. the Prior's rite, the founding ledger) versus flavor keepsakes — discovering the Prior's rite worked on the gray sergeant at the Waiting Bough felt like a lucky guess rather than a signposted solution.
